description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 118. Category: heroic. Heroic Features.

You have learned to put your whole body behind a
Power-Up, allowing you to use it in your
Transformation Slot. (This does not allow you to get
around any requirements for Power-Up activations. Ex:
No “Grade 4” without “SSJ 1”)
